name: Patrol Schedules
summary: At the Rebel Camp, Lieutenant Doren searches for the writer behind a note signed only with an initial. The writer says they shared patrol routes with Private Thorsen the previous week, and the duty records may reveal their name.

sections.title: A Clue in the Rosters
sections.body: A note found at the Rebel Camp bears the initial M. Its writer says they walked regular routes with Private Thorsen during the previous week. That may point to the one aiding the Kurzen forces. Lieutenant Doren sends you to Corporal Sethman, who keeps the duty logs. His records may show who patrolled beside Thorsen.

sections.title: What the Records Show
sections.body: Private Merle shared Thorsen's duty times and routes throughout the previous week. The match reveals Merle as the informant feeding intelligence to Kurzen's men. Merle flees the encampment toward Duskwood's northern boundary.

faq.q: Why does Lieutenant Doren send you to Corporal Sethman?
faq.answer: Corporal Sethman keeps the Rebel Camp's duty logs and schedules. The note says its writer walked regular routes with Private Thorsen, so Sethman's records may show who served beside him.

faq.q: What clue is found in the recovered note?
faq.answer: The recovered note bears the letter M. Its writer says they walked the same duty paths as Private Thorsen during the previous week.

faq.q: Where does this inquiry take place?
faq.answer: The inquiry takes place inside the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, between Lieutenant Doren and Corporal Sethman.
Before this inquiry, you brought Lieutenant Doren the muddy note found among Bookie Herod's valuables in The Spy Revealed! It bore only an initial.
